Operator revocation shipped and verified on hardware.

Three commits on main:
- 99cf140 tenant-scoped device-admin routes (GET /agent/devices, POST /agent/devices/{tokenHash}/revoke) on both the relay and the direct listener
- a5579c5 e2e.Store.RemoveDevice
- 20f34fc cmux-bridge devices list|revoke

Live verification 2026-08-11 against relay + direct listener: listing showed 19 relay + 3 direct tokens against 5 shared secrets (the drift, visible for the first time); a throwaway paired through each server appeared with SECRET yes and its token authenticated (200 vs 401 for a bad token); revoking it removed the row, dropped the e2e count by exactly one, and turned the token into a 401. Ambiguous and unknown prefixes both refused cleanly. Baseline state restored: 22 rows, 5 secrets, agent healthy.

The existing 19 were deliberately NOT reaped -- that is a separate act, and some rows may be worth identifying first.

Scope was 'operator revocation first' by design decision; the phone-side half is cmux-app-lts. Other follow-ups: cmux-app-bys, cmux-app-nvt, cmux-app-dle, cmux-app-xdc.

Shipped in 1d70253. revoke now takes a prefix of the 12-char hash devices list prints (exact wins, unique prefix resolves, ambiguous/unmatched refuse), scoped to the resolved device's own tenant via RevokeByHash; a raw token still works as a fallback for a leak. Live-verified 2026-08-11 on the relay: paired a throwaway, revoked it by prefix, its token went 401; ambiguous prefix '5' listed its 3 candidates and refused; unknown prefix refused. Mutation check: hardcoding the tenant fails the tests.

Shipped in a13f13a + b895671. Admin commands now open the store via cli.OpenExistingStore, which refuses to create one and names the path it looked at, and print which store answered. Running that fix live surfaced a second instance of the same trap: Go's flag package stops at the first positional, so 'devices list --config X' parsed no flags and read the default store -- now refused by parseAdminArgs. Both verified in-container on the live relay 2026-08-11.

Shipped in 88667b2 (route), cecc690 (reaper), 78a1bb9 (phone). Verified on hardware 2026-08-11 against both listeners: throwaway self-revoke 200 -> next request 401 -> second call 401 -> stranded secret shows as a 'local' row -> reaper's timed round removed exactly that row and no other. Direct listener answered with no envelope and no X-Cmux-Encrypted header, which is what the phone depends on. On the emulator: Forget removed exactly its own relay token from the server and left the real phone's untouched; Forget with airplane mode on still cleared both slots locally with the server listing byte-identical and no crash.

Fixed in 47b9520. The open question (how the server knows which row a re-pair supersedes) is answered by self-revoke from cmux-app-f5y: the phone still holds the old bearer token at commit time and the server takes the device from it, so no wire change was needed. PairingClient captures the superseded config before commitInternal overwrites it and retires it from inside onCredentialsReplaced, which already fires last and only on an accepted pairing. Live-verified on the emulator against the relay: re-pair replaced relay row 5cdccfe95509 with 17151cbbfa76 instead of adding one (19 relay rows before and after), old secret dropped to a 'local' row and was reaped, app kept working on the new credential.

Fixed in 8d8388f (relay) + 4d57e39 (agent): each server tracks live device sockets and re-runs its connect-time predicate on a 30s sweep, tearing down sockets whose device is no longer paired. Covers out-of-process CLI revocation, which no call-site hook could. Hardware-verified on the emulator 2026-08-13: sweep closed a revoked device's socket in 1.6s while the real phone's connection was untouched. Relay half is committed but NOT yet deployed to 192.168.1.160 (SSH key access unavailable).
Gate all 3 socket subscriptions on app foreground (MainActivity onStart/onStop -> BridgeGateway.appForeground); badge refetch now only on feed frames. Tests+detekt green.

Root cause: opencode enables DECSET mouse reporting (1000/1002/1003/1006) -> PTY scrollback stays empty; app only rendered replay scrollback. Fix: DecodedGrid.mouseReporting parsed from modes; TerminalScreen routes vertical swipes on such panes to SGR wheel events (ESC[<64/65;c;rM) into the TUI - same as Mac trackpad. Claude-code panes (mouse off) keep local 240-row scroll.
